summary: Retested login bug fix on preview URL. All 5 scenarios pass: (1) normal login with seeded admin lands on dashboard, (2) whitespace-padded password ' Cocoa@2026 ' logs in successfully (trim works), (3) mixed-case email 'Olowokandevincent0@Gmail.com' logs in successfully (lowercase works), (4) wrong password shows 'Incorrect email or password' error, (5) show/hide password toggle switches input type between password<->text correctly. The reported 'incorrect password' bug is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx correctly trims + lowercases email and trims password; inputs have autoCapitalize=none/autoCorrect=off/spellCheck=false and correct autoComplete values.
Toggle password visibility button toggles input type properly and has proper aria-label.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow fully validated on preview URL. Backend login POST /api/auth/login returns 200 and sets cookie; 401s in console logs are the initial /api/auth/me probe before login (expected).
rca of the issue: Original 'incorrect password' issue was caused by mobile/browser auto-capitalization on email field and possible trailing whitespace. Fix: email trimmed+lowercased and password trimmed client-side before submit, plus autoCapitalize=none/autoCorrect=off on both inputs. Verified working.
